items.evidence: RTM: catalogue pack/read + category-policy wired; product duplicate-detection wired (POST /v1/catalogue/products/duplicates); product-master WRITE PATH wired (POST /v1/catalogue/products/:id/publish behind the compliance gate + GET reads, event-sourced latest-per-id, integration-tested); barcode register WRITE PATH wired (POST /v1/catalogue/products/:id/barcodes/:code enforcing one-code-one-item via the tested BarcodeRegistry + lookup/list reads, event-sourced, integration-tested); tax-class GST-RATE SCHEDULE wired (POST /v1/catalogue/tax-classes/:hsn/rates/:date via the tested resolveGstRate, per-HSN effective-dated, one-rate-per-date, + resolve/list reads, integration-tested); catalogue-pack ASSEMBLY + SIGNED PUBLISH now wired (GET /v1/catalogue/pack/preview folds product master + prices + barcodes + tax rates into one snapshot for a store, AND POST /v1/catalogue/pack now BUILDS the signed pack from that same fold — an authored+priced+barcoded+taxed product reaches the lane on the signed pack it reads, an unpriced one is never shipped; integration-tested end to end incl. the shrink guard); product-authoring SCREEN write path underway (slices 1-2: the tested ProductPublishRequested outbox command + the shell Publish button now commits it to a DEVICE-backed catalogue outbox via catalogue-session.requestPublish — Save validates then durably queues, no network from the screen; unit-tested); product-publish delivery per owner decision ADR-0013 (signed-in operator delivers, not a service identity) — slice 1 the tested review-queue classifier + slice 2 the tested operator-session delivery (deliverReadyPublishes sends only ready items via an injected operator-auth port to the idempotent publish route, acknowledging/holding/dead-lettering on result, no auto-publish) + slice 3 the tested review-queue SCREEN session model (createProductPublishReviewSession presents the whole outbox incl. visible dead-letters/published items, each with a live word+icon state re-evaluated from the operator's CURRENT context, attention-first ordering, plain-English exception guidance, bilingual EN/TA, a nobody-named refusal, and a SEPARATE deliver() action delegating to slice 2 — no auto-publish on view/login) + slice 4 the SHELL + edge wiring (web/product-publish-review.html+.js opens offline via the shared web-erp SW, draws rows + a Publish button that runs ONLY on an explicit click; browser-entry boots it over the SAME device-backed catalogue outbox the Save commits to, with a concrete operator-session delivery port POSTing to the idempotent publish route under credentials:'same-origin' — the operator's own auth cookie, never a service token; registered as a served screen with PackProductPublishReviewPolicy feeding only the operator's CURRENT context re-read each render, menu gated catalogue.pack.publish; usability guardrail + offline e2e + screen-feed tests) + slice 5 the CENTRAL-BOUNDARY re-checks + audit (the cloud publish route trusts no client verdict: re-runs the tested publishProduct compliance gate AND adds SKU uniqueness across the whole tenant — a SKU held by a DIFFERENT product is refused 409 sku_already_in_use, nothing overwritten, while same-product re-publish is a legitimate new version; audit attribution [ADR-0013 control 10] is already provided by the kernel — a SHA-256-sealed append-only audit_log row per write and per refusal, naming the AUTHENTICATED userId, FND-02) landed; remaining M03 gaps keeping it PARTIALLY_WIRED not WIRED: the barcode-assignment leg of delivery (publish route takes product+categories; the command's barcodes assign on the separate barcode route), the ADR-0013 browser E2E matrix, the §28 reversible merge-write, and EmbeddedBarcodeRule weight/price-embedded not yet sourced on the cloud
